example.title: Pismo Beach Pier end platform (pier rebuilt 1985, 2019)
example.place: Pismo Beach, San Luis Obispo County, CA

brief: The widened end of a timber pier: a broad plank deck on a forest of creosoted piles with cross-bracing, a white timber rail round three sides with a 'no overhead casting' board, a lamp post and a small shelter, standing well above the surf. Three photos. Piles carried 10 m or more below the modelled bed (spec rule 4).
